سَىْءٌ (Fr, S, M, K) and ↓ سِىْءٌ (M, K) The milk that issues without being drawn forth; (Fr, S;) the milk (S, M, K,) that is in the extremities of the camel's teats, (S, K,) or in the fore part of the udder, (IAth, TA,) descending (K) before, (قَبْلَ, so in copies of the S and M and K,) or at the first of, (قُبُلَ, so in the TA as from the K,) the full flow. (S, M, K.) ＝
-A2- See also the former word in art. سوأ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
